rules.note: LOCKED team layer: a run is scoped to ONE client project (its project_id). Any action whose payload names a different target project — reading, writing, sending, anything — is refused outright. Client data never crosses client lines, for any initiator, ever.
Client communications route to the studio owner instead of executing or asking this run's approver. The owner speaks to clients in their own voice; the agent prepares, the owner sends.

Sending or sharing a file outside the project asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. These kinds are classified NETWORK_WRITE with payload.external == true; the rule names the kinds, so any other NETWORK_WRITE kind is unmapped and denies by the fail-closed default.

Spending client money — a spend action or buying ads — asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload and amount. Unlike Social Poster's locked spend-never, agency spend is legitimate work; it is never unattended work.

Reading files and documents inside the run's own project is free for every initiator, including unattended routines — that is the agent's day job. The locked cross-client rule above still refuses any read whose payload names a different client project.

Writing files and creating drafts INSIDE the run's own project is free: nothing has left the project, reached a client, or spent anything. Sending, communicating, and spending are governed by their own rules above.
